uomo.aspetto: a stocky man in his fifties with curly grey hair, bulging eyes and a grimacing mouth, in a stained navy tracksuit with white stripes

parti.occhi: His eyes are glassy and bloodshot with fever, the rims red and watery, drops of sweat on his forehead and temples.
parti.bocca: Yellowed teeth with a gap, grey stubble around the mouth, chapped lips; nothing else unusual.
parti.collo: A thick, sweaty neck with grey stubble and the collar of the tracksuit; no swelling, no lumps.
parti.mani: Big sweaty hands with cracked knuckles and short dirty nails; the skin is healthy.

giovane.aspetto: a very pale young woman in her twenties with long dark hair, bulging tired eyes and sunken cheeks, in a long grey cardigan

parti.occhi: Pale skin with dark circles under the eyes. Her irises are dark brown and the whites of her eyes are clear and white: no redness, no fever, no cataract, no clouding.
parti.bocca: Very pale, almost bluish lips, as if she were cold and exhausted; healthy teeth.
parti.collo: A thin, very pale neck with faint blue veins under the skin; no swelling, no lumps.

ascelle.inquadratura: her left armpit: she raises her arm, the grey cardigan pulled back over a thin sleeveless top
ascelle.segni: Pale skin with no swelling and no marks at all.

parti.mani: Pale, cold-looking hands with slightly bluish nails; the skin is healthy.

nonna.aspetto: a very old woman in her eighties with thin white hair, bulging eyes and a hooked nose, in a quilted dark floral housecoat

parti.occhi: Very old eyes clouded with milky cataracts, deep wrinkles all around, but not red and not feverish.
parti.bocca: An almost toothless mouth with a single crooked tooth left, deep wrinkles around the lips; she is smirking.
parti.collo: A very wrinkled old neck with a thin chain and a small tarnished religious medal; no swelling.
parti.mani: Gnarled old hands with swollen arthritic knuckles, thin skin with age spots and a worn wedding ring; healthy.
